newsitem.title: JORDAN: Jordan's PM to hold talks with Arafat.
newsitem.headline: Jordan's PM to hold talks with Arafat.

text.p: Jordan's Prime Minister Abdul-Salam al-Majali will hold talks on Sunday with Palestinian leader Yasser Arafat in the Palestinian self-ruled West Bank town of Ramallah, officials said on Saturday.

They said Majali, accompanied by both ministers of health and trade and industry, would meet Arafat in Ramallah for talks on boosting coordination and reviewing ways of breaking the impasse in Israeli-Palestinian peace talks.

Palestinian officials have recently stepped up visits to Amman to brief Jordanian officials on latest efforts to jump-start talks with the Israelis, frozen since Israel broke ground on a settlement in Arab East Jerusalem in March.
Jordan is worried about rising tensions in the wake of a heightened Jewish settlement drive pursued by Israeli Prime Minister's Benjamin Netanyahu's government in the West Bank.

Officials fear any repercussions on the kingdom's security triggered by widescale violence in the Palestinian territories and King Hussein has recently blamed Netanyahu for a breakdown in the peacemaking.
